senses.gloss: bittuvaṭṭa (A. R. Ep., 1958-59, p. 10), Kannaḍa; probably also called bittukaṭṭe; explained as ‘a portion of the produce derived from the lands irrigated by tanks, or wet land irrigated by a tank, granted to the person who built the tank or repaired it.’
bittu-vaṭṭa , a portion of the produce from the land irrigated [] by a tank, granted to a person who excavated or repaired the tank (A. R. Ep., 1958-59, p. 10).
